best_match.fbbt_definition: An elongating spermatid, 200-500 micrometers in length and in which nuclear shaping has begun. The two parts of the mitochondrial derivative become unequal in size.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00057000 'early-mid elongation-stage spermatid', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
